This position is responsible for managing the end-to-end procurement process in support of administrative and research operations. The role drafts and executes purchase orders, coordinates vendor onboarding, obtains quotes, places orders (including PalCard transactions), and ensures all approvals and documentation are completed and maintained in systems such as KFS and UCIBuy+. The incumbent partners with faculty, staff, and vendors to gather requirements, negotiate pricing and terms, and facilitate timely, cost-effective purchasing of supplies, equipment, and services. The position also serves as the Procurement point of contact for Office of Research external units, providing procurement guidance and coordinating procurement-related matters with units, vendors, and central offices.

The position ensures compliance with university, state, federal, and sponsored research policies, collaborates with post-award finance staff to verify allowability of expenses, and serves as a liaison between organizational units, vendors, and central offices to resolve purchasing and payment issues. Responsibilities also include reconciling transactions, reconciling monthly ledgers, maintaining procurement records, performing basic cost analyses, supporting financial reporting, processing and reviewing Travel, Entertainment, and Disbursement Voucher transactions, maintaining staff training records and role assignments for PalCard and procurement systems, and updating procurement resources for Office of Research staff and external units. The position also assists with audits to identify and address potential compliance concerns.
NOTE: This is primarily a remote position; infrequently, this position will need to or be required to work on campus.
